title: Private Secret Spots Tour on Oahu Hawaii
includes: Car seats or booster seats for children
Admission to other activities with an entry fee (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This tour is similar to our 8 hour Custom, Private tour, except with this tour, we can stop at the secret spots that big bus tours can't stop at. These spots are so secret, we can't tell you in advance, but for the you'll get to see places that you won't see on other tours. You'll learn even more about the History and Culture of Hawaii, and see some truly beautiful scenery. Your tour guide will work with you on the itinerary and route for the day to customize it to your desires.
